description.zh:
配合**SortingField**参数一起使用，指定字段排序方式。取值：

- **true**：升序。
- **false**：降序。
description.en:
The sorting order, used together with the **SortingField** parameter. Valid values:

- **true**: ascending order.
- **false**: descending order.

description.zh: 模糊匹配分组中的节点DevEUI。
description.en: The DevEUI of a node in the group for fuzzy match.

description.zh: 模糊匹配节点分组所使用的JoinEUI。
description.en: The JoinEUI used by the node group for fuzzy match.

description.zh: 模糊匹配节点分组名称。
description.en: The node group name for fuzzy match.

description.zh:
实例ID。
您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

> 如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。
description.en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.

> If the public instance does not have an ID value, refer to [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).

description.zh: 本次查询的分组数量，取值范围0~200。
description.en: The number of groups to query. Valid values: 0 to 200.

description.zh: 本次查询的起始位置，从0开始。
description.en: The start position of this query, starting from 0.

description.zh: 指定排序字段，取值为**CREATED_MILLIS**，表示根据创建时间排序。
description.en: The sorting field. Set the value to **CREATED_MILLIS**, which indicates sorting by creation time.

descriptions.zh:
# 限制说明

单阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为5。

> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
# Before you begin

The maximum number of queries per second (QPS) per Alibaba Cloud account for this operation is 5.

> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
